style.vernacular: Egba capital in wooded savanna broken by grey granite outcrops: dense low-rise quarters of single- and two-storey cement-rendered houses in cream, ochre and pastel paint with rusting corrugated iron roofs, a few 19th-century Saro (returnee) houses with Afro-Brazilian verandas, red-brick mission churches in Ake, laterite red-earth lanes and granite boulders poking through the town.
style.ornament: Painted and cowrie-studded geometric panels on palace and museum veranda pillars; colonnaded colonial verandas in Ake; Afro-Brazilian (Saro) gables and balcony details on old returnee houses; indigo adire patterns; shrine and cave openings in granite at Olumo.
